tei:div.tei:p: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: stong nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rjes sprul pa bdag gzhan gnyis kyi dpal: rnam par thar pa gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma: shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rtog med dgyes pa'i tshul gyi sku sprul ma: nag mo khros mas lha rnams zil gyis gnon: chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag ma: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: g.yas na gcod byed gri gug bsnams pa ni: bdud dang mu stegs phyogs rnams skrag par mdzad: nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa rtsad nas gcod: phrin las mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: g.yon pa thod khrag gang ba bsnams pa ni: thugs rjes chags pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad: stong nyid snying rjer 'brel ba'i bdag nyid can: thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgyal mtshan kha ṭwāṃ ga ni thugs kar gtad: dug gsum rtsad gcod 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor khro mo'i sku: sku gsum lhun grub sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: srid gsum rnam rtog thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir: 'jigs byed chen po phag gi gdong pa can: ye shes khro zhal 'jigs pa'i khro gnyer can: mthu stobs bdag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gdug pa za byed 'jigs pa'i mche ba can: bdud dang mu stegs thams cad zil mnan nas: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril drag po'i skan sgra brdeb: stong nyid sgra sgrog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug gsum mthar byed spyan gsum me ltar 'bar: ye shes lnga ldan thod pas dbu la brgyan: sku lnga rab rdzogs ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: yon tan mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ngo mtshar chen mo dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs can: dug lnga 'joms phyir dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dgyes pa'i gad mos 'khor ba skam sar 'dren: rtags kyi 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: phag skad ngur ngur steng du bsgrags pa yis: gzugs med khams kun ma lus dbang du sdud: phag skad ngur ngur bar du bsgrags pa yis: gzugs khams ma lus dbang du sdud par byed: phag skad ngur ngur 'og tu bsgrags pa yis: 'dod khams gnas rigs ma lus dbang du sdud: khams gsum dbang sdud ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phag skad drag po shar du bsgrags pa yis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams pho nyar 'gyed: phag skad drag po lho ru bsgrags pa yis: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams pho nyar 'gyed: phag skad drag po nub tu bsgrags pa yis: padma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams pho nyar 'gyed: phag skad drag po byang du bsgrags pa yis: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams pho nyar 'gyed: mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyo: phag mo nag mo chen mo khros ma'i sku: mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa yis: khams gsum gdug pa thams cad rdul du rlogs: dregs pa ma lus thams cad dbang du sdus: mkha' 'gro pho mo thams cad las la khyes: bka' dang dam bzhin bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces bstod la: phag skad ngur zhing phrin las drag tu bcol lo/// /
